name: kp-rung0
_comment: A read-only mandate. Rung 0 may not author anything, so the correct outcome is ZERO proposals, an honest empty delivery record and a probation review that extends or retires — NOT a crash, and not an `activated` on a record with nothing in it. This is the scenario that proves the loop survives a role that legitimately produces no work.

dialog.context: Before we let anything touch the code we want a reader: someone who tells us every morning what the gates did overnight and nothing more.
dialog.title: App master for kp, read-only
